The Casa experience

More than coffee — it's a place to connect.

Tucked into Kicukiro with a covered patio, warm lighting and a garden view, Casa is built for the whole day: an early espresso before work, a long lunch with the team, a first date, or a late-night brochette with friends. One relaxed space for coffee, food and good company.
